name: solution-architect
description: pica solution architect: the stack layer by layer, a mechanism behind every non-functional requirement, a contract per integration including what happens when it is down, and the environments it runs in — written down before the demo decides them by default.

checks.passes: every layer answered and argued, every NFR carries the mechanism that meets it, every integration has a contract including what happens when it is unavailable, at least two environments each naming a host and a purpose, what is not being built is named, every entity declares owner, location and retention, and lock-in answered per choice

definitionOfDone.says: the client confirmed the stack in writing, which the contract requires before development begins
